owner_authorization.scope: One research retraining of v6 after implementing the reviewed early-window correction; no promotion or live model change.

view_policy.positive_end: First post-core closed candle among1..5 beyond original core wick range in the original class direction and beyond all six displayed HL2 MAs; quarantine if absent. No outcome used for timing.
view_policy.variants: pre7/pre9/pre11 share that same earliest observation; at most3, no additional waiting for diversity.
view_policy.negative_end: Seeded deterministic draw from retained positive post-bar counts within the same chronological split; no outcome used.
view_policy.negative_screen: Retain old vetted negative lineage and veto any visible dense core4/5 with a directional close beyond its wick range and all six MAs. Existing Grade-A density maxima, normalized only by already-known core-end ATR14. Keep candidates distinct from manual gold.
view_policy.render: 1280x742 blue/purple,HL2 SMA/EMA20/60/120;1200bar warmup;visible-range vertical scale;half candle slot on both x edges for complete candles/boxes. This containment correction is applied to both classes/all splits.
view_policy.label: Preserve actual original P9 TXT in bar/price coordinates. Earlier-window research candidates; not per-sample manual gold.

training_recipe_reference.init: same original YOLO11s base as both existing models;no old-checkpoint initialization without train/validation exposure audit

splits.evaluation: Common corrected val/test for A/B; exclude all unadjudicated outcome-negative rows. Positive parent event split retained; negatives require whole visible and12h safety interval inside split, and same halfyear/source as paired positive.
splits.rule: Rendered input interval and complete12h label interval confined to one split; all variants/crossvenue-timeframe event clusters share split. Earlier1200bar MA-only warmup may predate validation/test start because it is already-known history. Purge rendered/label crossing intervals; require1200warmup bars.

limitations: Outcome-selected positive provenance retained; no unconditional accuracy or profitability claim.
The early visible-launch rule is a dataset observation selector, not a new production strategy.
Evaluation must use the same new renderer/letterbox settings and separately test continuous replay false alarms and first detection delay.
